<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Exam reforms:</strong> The Centre has informed the Supreme Court that a committee led by Nandan Nilekani has been established to oversee comprehensive reforms for competitive examinations.</li>
  <li><strong>Judicial scrutiny:</strong> The Supreme Court has issued a notice regarding a plea by Kapil Sibal, highlighting significant concerns and &quot;enormous issues&quot; regarding the current anti-defection law.</li>
</ul>
